description: Look up one US public water system by its PWSID (e.g. IL0970450). Returns the system's identity, type (community, transient, non-transient non-community), population served, service connections, owner and source type, the counties it serves, its current health-based violations (unresolved MCL, MRDL, and treatment-technique violations) from EPA SDWIS, plus its latest lead/copper 90th-percentile result and a summary of its UCMR5 PFAS sampling (whether sampled, analytes detected, maximum concentration). Use this when you already know the PWSID; if you only have a name or place, use search_water_systems first. This is the bundled overview — for the full monitoring-period lead/copper history use get_system_lead_copper, and for full per-analyte PFAS results use get_system_pfas. An unknown PWSID returns a no_data result, not an empty profile.
